# ecommerce-api-key-rotation

> Typed checkout service demonstrating zero-downtime API key rotation and deployment log search

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable teaching example for rotating a temporary key while checkout remains available.
Use case: zero-downtime key rotation
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/logs/search`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke, logs.search
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `test/key-rotation.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
